description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mouse_and_the_girl), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/mag1), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54878647), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4419000181), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5029144)

A prince turned into a mouse for speaking ill of a fairy. Just as he was about to meet his end as a worthless being, the life-saver who saved him is... Cinderella?! But she is somehow different from the pitiful heroines seen so far!
